c10_live.first.lead.01.speaker: nora
c10_live.first.lead.01.text: Orchard is listening for you, Steve. The pier is watching Orchard.
c10_live.first.lead.01.synthesis_text: Orchard is listening for you, Steve. The pier is watching Orchard.
c10_live.first.lead.01.previous_text: It’s on mine too. Stay with me.
c10_live.first.lead.01.next_text: Careful. Two Pier lamps are still on from the rehearsal. Don’t count those.

c10_live.second.lead.04.speaker: steve
c10_live.second.lead.04.text: The fourth signal goes out on beat forty. Shaw goes when the coast answers. Wen needs the next two beats.
c10_live.second.lead.04.synthesis_text: The fourth signal goes out on beat forty. Shaw goes when the coast answers. Wen needs the next two beats.
c10_live.second.lead.04.previous_text: Bell kept answering anyway. So Bell is only an echo inside the building.
c10_live.second.lead.04.next_text: And my power crew needs everything back by the start of beat forty-five.

c10_station.relay.lead.01.speaker: frank
c10_station.relay.lead.01.text: Yesterday I sent signal three. Today I’m sending signal four. Let’s see who keeps up.
c10_station.relay.lead.01.synthesis_text: Yesterday I sent signal three. Today I’m sending signal four. Let’s see who keeps up.
c10_station.relay.lead.01.previous_text: K7BLW calling the Thursday club. We’re going to need a few more operators.
c10_station.relay.lead.01.next_text: The official channel just sent back three. That’s yesterday’s cue.

c10_station.talk.stephen.1.02.speaker: steve
c10_station.talk.stephen.1.02.text: You do. Black and very strong, two cups before breakfast.
c10_station.talk.stephen.1.02.synthesis_text: You do. Black and very strong, two cups before breakfast.
c10_station.talk.stephen.1.02.previous_text: Is there coffee? I remember liking coffee.
c10_station.talk.stephen.1.02.next_text: Good. That one is still mine. I’m keeping it.

c10_town.talk.wen.1.03.speaker: wen
c10_town.talk.wen.1.03.text: It did not. My test fooled two admirals as well.
c10_town.talk.wen.1.03.synthesis_text: It did not. My test fooled two admirals as well.
c10_town.talk.wen.1.03.previous_text: You tried. And my fake fooled more generals than yours.
c10_town.talk.wen.1.03.next_text: I brought the fog machine. Just in case.

c2_aquarium.intercom.lead.02.speaker: steve
c2_aquarium.intercom.lead.02.text: The paper on the spool is dated in her handwriting. May twenty ninth.
c2_aquarium.intercom.lead.02.synthesis_text: The paper on the spool is dated in her handwriting. May twenty ninth.
c2_aquarium.intercom.lead.02.previous_text: Two short notes. If Admiral can hear me, perhaps somebody else can.
c2_aquarium.intercom.lead.02.next_text: Her second note goes up. Like it always did, before this summer.

c2_ship.escape.lead.03.speaker: steve
c2_ship.escape.lead.03.text: Two speaker covers by my hand. The attendant tested the hall speakers on the cracked one.
c2_ship.escape.lead.03.synthesis_text: Two speaker covers by my hand. The attendant tested the hall speakers on the cracked one.
c2_ship.escape.lead.03.previous_text: Dad’s recorder caught three voices tonight. Nora’s spool, the attendant, and the Prefect.
c2_ship.escape.lead.03.next_text: When my sleeve brushed the other grille, the chair’s lamp blinked.

c3_house.rules.lead.04.speaker: calder
c3_house.rules.lead.04.text: Walt moved to Washington in April. His signature is on a permit here, dated a day he was testifying in Washington.
c3_house.rules.lead.04.synthesis_text: Walt moved to Washington in April. His signature is on a permit here, dated a day he was testifying in Washington.
c3_house.rules.lead.04.previous_text: Mateo’s coaching book. Lyle missed every game last spring. From June eleventh, he signed in at every one.
c3_house.rules.lead.04.next_text: Two I could take to a judge. And if I do, what do I tell Lyle’s boys? Mateo says they’ve never been happier.

c4_safe.screens.02.speaker: steve
c4_safe.screens.02.text: And a list of placements in Washington and Beijing. The first name on it is Walt, from June’s list.
c4_safe.screens.02.synthesis_text: And a list of placements in Washington and Beijing. The first name on it is Walt, from June’s list.
c4_safe.screens.02.previous_text: Adrian Rook, asleep in bed 41B. Both governments’ seals on the transfer. And an empty bed waiting for President Ward on signing day.
c4_safe.screens.02.next_text: The real Adrian Rook is asleep on that ship, in bed 41B. They have people in Washington and in Beijing. And they’ve made up a bed for President Ward, for the day she signs the accord.

c5_shack.notes.lead.02.speaker: steve
c5_shack.notes.lead.02.text: Coltrane was Dad’s favorite record. And weather carts are the little weather tapes we played on air at KBWR.
c5_shack.notes.lead.02.synthesis_text: Coltrane was Dad’s favorite record. And weather carts are the little weather tapes we played on air at KBWR.
c5_shack.notes.lead.02.previous_text: I missed you both so much I stopped looking at anything you left.
c5_shack.notes.lead.02.next_text: The good stuff. Dad’s name for the station library.

c5_shack.rig.lead.03.speaker: steve
c5_shack.rig.lead.03.text: Dad’s rule for packs. Same volts, same center pin, and at least as much current as the card asks for.
c5_shack.rig.lead.03.synthesis_text: Dad’s rule for packs. Same volts, same center pin, and at least as much current as the card asks for.
c5_shack.rig.lead.03.previous_text: Every set has a rating card, Dad said. Read it before you plug anything in.
c5_shack.rig.lead.03.next_text: His log says the dial reads a little high. The same amount, every time.

c6_jail.distract.lead.03.speaker: steve
c6_jail.distract.lead.03.text: She leaves at 11:59 and she’s back at 12:03. I need two clear minutes.
c6_jail.distract.lead.03.synthesis_text: She leaves at 11:59 and she’s back at 12:03. I need two clear minutes.
c6_jail.distract.lead.03.previous_text: The clerk says a contested likeness sends the deputy down to the basement for the file.
c6_jail.distract.lead.03.next_text: I would like a better photograph. My family will be seeing these.

c6_jail.talk.pell.1.01.speaker: steve
c6_jail.talk.pell.1.01.text: How is Biscuit doing these days?
c6_jail.talk.pell.1.01.synthesis_text: How is Biscuit doing these days?
c6_jail.talk.pell.1.01.previous_text: He never smiles before ten. I can vouch for that personally.
c6_jail.talk.pell.1.01.next_text: She eats at seven and at five. She prefers the blue bowl. I am not yet sure she prefers me.

c6_jail.talk.pell.2.03.speaker: pell
c6_jail.talk.pell.2.03.text: I have started to like a twelfth. Carmen gives me a churro at La Marea. The real Dale never stopped there.
c6_jail.talk.pell.2.03.synthesis_text: I have started to like a twelfth. Carmen gives me a churro at La Marea. The real Dale never stopped there.
c6_jail.talk.pell.2.03.previous_text: Dale’s route has two hundred and twelve stops. Dale liked eleven of them.
c6_jail.talk.pell.2.03.next_text: What is Dale like? The real one.

c7_gate.talk.pell.1.01.speaker: steve
c7_gate.talk.pell.1.01.text: Who is looking after Biscuit today?
c7_gate.talk.pell.1.01.synthesis_text: Who is looking after Biscuit today?
c7_gate.talk.pell.1.01.previous_text: I can’t. This is the most fun I’ve had in my whole short life.
c7_gate.talk.pell.1.01.next_text: The Sheriff’s neighbor. I left written instructions. Four pages, with diagrams.

c7_swap.tone.lead.02.speaker: calder
c7_swap.tone.lead.02.text: The team gets to the patient at 11:58 and fourteen seconds. Not one second sooner.
c7_swap.tone.lead.02.synthesis_text: The team gets to the patient at 11:58 and fourteen seconds. Not one second sooner.
c7_swap.tone.lead.02.previous_text: Service tunnel. We see them. Give us a few seconds.
c7_swap.tone.lead.02.next_text: The speakers switch to the anthem at eighteen seconds past. Your tone runs two seconds. It has to finish before then.

c8_lab.talk.wen.3.01.speaker: steve
c8_lab.talk.wen.3.01.text: How long have you two known each other?
c8_lab.talk.wen.3.01.synthesis_text: How long have you two known each other?
c8_lab.talk.wen.3.01.previous_text: Perfect Mandarin. Then she asked me if I needed any bait.
c8_lab.talk.wen.3.01.next_text: Nine years. We were enemies for one week and friends ever since.

c8_rig.path.lead.02.speaker: wen
c8_rig.path.lead.02.text: The dock receipt says a camera saw the lamps. The mast receipt says the ship measured them. The shore receipt says the ship got our crew’s numbers.
c8_rig.path.lead.02.synthesis_text: The dock receipt says a camera saw the lamps. The mast receipt says the ship measured them. The shore receipt says the ship got our crew’s numbers.
c8_rig.path.lead.02.previous_text: I ran a paper trial. Three receipts. Only one of them would convince me, if I were them.
c8_rig.path.lead.02.next_text: The fleet trusts nothing that its own ship did not measure.

c8_rig.rig.lead.03.speaker: shaw
c8_rig.rig.lead.03.text: We need a signal going out and nothing coming back. Otherwise the ship hears my theater.
c8_rig.rig.lead.03.synthesis_text: We need a signal going out and nothing coming back. Otherwise the ship hears my theater.
c8_rig.rig.lead.03.previous_text: I tested all three twice. Once to see the cue go out, and once to hear what leaks back.
c8_rig.rig.lead.03.next_text: Careful. A dead coupler also lets nothing back. It looks perfect until you check the cue.

c9_wake.agnes.lead.03.speaker: nora
c9_wake.agnes.lead.03.text: The row list says the sleeper marked OT is on her left, and MV is on her right.
c9_wake.agnes.lead.03.synthesis_text: The row list says the sleeper marked OT is on her left, and MV is on her right.
c9_wake.agnes.lead.03.previous_text: Her glasses case still has a price sticker from her bait shop. That one is hers.
c9_wake.agnes.lead.03.next_text: My glasses. Has somebody changed the price of bait while I was gone?

c9_wake.talk.nora.1.02.speaker: steve
c9_wake.talk.nora.1.02.text: All that shouting? I can believe that.
c9_wake.talk.nora.1.02.synthesis_text: All that shouting? I can believe that.
c9_wake.talk.nora.1.02.previous_text: We kept this aisle open with a mop handle and a lot of shouting.
c9_wake.talk.nora.1.02.next_text: Mostly mine. Dale helped. He shouts like a man who has met a lot of dogs.

epilogue.talk.agnes.1.02.speaker: steve
epilogue.talk.agnes.1.02.text: Won’t you miss the wind back home?
epilogue.talk.agnes.1.02.synthesis_text: Won’t you miss the wind back home?
epilogue.talk.agnes.1.02.previous_text: The ship left without me, Steven. I asked it to.
epilogue.talk.agnes.1.02.next_text: I have the wind on a spool. I would miss the people more.

epilogue.talk.helen.1.01.speaker: helen
epilogue.talk.helen.1.01.text: Your father leaves me a note every morning now. Today’s note says the kettle is labeled.
epilogue.talk.helen.1.01.synthesis_text: Your father leaves me a note every morning now. Today’s note says the kettle is labeled.
epilogue.talk.helen.1.01.previous_text: Tell June I’m sorry about the voicemail.
epilogue.talk.helen.1.01.next_text: Is the kettle actually labeled now?

i1_archive.quiet.lead.03.speaker: archivist
i1_archive.quiet.lead.03.text: The newest went quiet three hundred years ago. The other six went quiet at least five hundred years ago.
i1_archive.quiet.lead.03.synthesis_text: The newest went quiet three hundred years ago. The other six went quiet at least five hundred years ago.
i1_archive.quiet.lead.03.previous_text: Seven worlds with people on them. Every one went quiet soon after the fleet arrived.
i1_archive.quiet.lead.03.next_text: The sleeper in Row Zero came aboard three hundred years ago. It has never said a word.

p_meeting.talk.general_us.2.03.speaker: general_us
p_meeting.talk.general_us.2.03.text: Then I hope your husband enjoyed the show.
p_meeting.talk.general_us.2.03.synthesis_text: Then I hope your husband enjoyed the show.
p_meeting.talk.general_us.2.03.previous_text: My husband is a ham. He talked about it at dinner for a week.
p_meeting.talk.general_us.2.03.next_text: Your building has no windows, Mrs. Mercer. And no tea.
